views.text: In September 2025, Equity Mates used Credit Suisse as an example of how a loss of depositor confidence can wipe out equity and tier one hybrids before losses hit tier two, senior debt and deposits, to explain the risks in a bank capital stack.

views.text: In March 2023, Equity Mates recapped that Credit Suisse shares fell more than 30% in a single day and it was then acquired by UBS after authorities intervened, highlighting how quickly confidence collapsed.
